fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2013 Mitsubishi Outlander Sport SUV.
findings: Dull, hazy paint on the rear liftgate panel above the badge, with what looks like clear coat failure or heavy oxidation
Flat, low-gloss paint along the driver side doors and rear quarter
Dusty, grimy black lower rocker trim along the driver side
Brake dust and grime on the silver alloy wheels
Small chip or white spot on the liftgate near the wiper
Dirt and grime in the rear wheel well liner area
message: Hi, we saw your Outlander Sport listing and noticed the liftgate paint above the badge looks hazy and the side paint is a bit flat in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a machine buff and trim restoration, and can come to you in the Saint Paul area. Would you like a quote?
